e.summary_hk: **v-star**（倉庫 `lubasinkal/v-star`）**是一個**用 Go 寫的**零依賴精算引擎****——**逐字自述為**「**# v-star: The Actuarial Engine That Doesn**」**——**逐字續**「**’t Suck**」**，**並**逐字開場**「**Your calculations just got millions of times faster.**」**。**本次實測**：**許可 MIT**、**語言 Go**、**創建 2026-03-17**、**最後推送 2026-07-30**、**★2**、**倉庫約 14.5 MB****、**版本文檔最新一條為 **0.9.0**（**2026-05-29**）**、**共 103 個檔案／**23 個 Go 測試檔案****。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**另一種語言的同題材實現，**以及**倉庫裡那份給 AI 代理的檔案**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **⭐ 名字的來歷被寫明**（**逐字**「**if premiums compound at rate j but you**」**——**逐字續**「**’re discounting at i, the new discount factor is v* = (1+j) × v**」**）**；**② **它在一台**具體型號的筆記本 CPU** 上**逐項列出**基準**，**並**與 Polars／**Pandas** 對比**；**③ **能力表**把每一項**翻成**「**對你意味著什麼**」**；**④ **⭐ 而**倉庫裡**除了 Go 代碼**，**還有一個 Zig 子目錄（11 個檔案）**與**一份 `AGENTS.md`****。**⚠️ 本次**未安裝、**未運行**。
e.summary_en: This repository **is a zero-dependency actuarial engine written in Go**, whose readme titles itself the actuarial engine that does not suck and opens by claiming that the reader calculations just got millions of times faster. **Measured this round**: MIT licensed, created in March and last pushed at the end of July, two stars, a repository of about fourteen and a half megabytes, a changelog whose latest entry is version 0.9.0 from late May, and a hundred and three files including twenty-three Go test files. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the same subject implemented in another language, together with the instruction file for AI coding agents that such repositories now ship.** **Four things are worth reading: the name origin is written out, coming from a classroom joke in which premiums compound at one rate while discounting happens at another, giving a modified discount factor; the readme publishes per-item benchmarks on a named laptop processor and compares them against two widely used dataframe tools; the capability table translates every feature into what it means for the reader, covering present values, annuities, reserves, Monte Carlo simulation with two rate models, risk measures, multiple decrements, large CSV streaming and an HTTP interface; and the repository contains not only Go code but also a Zig subdirectory of eleven files and an instruction file for AI coding agents.** **The project was not installed and not run this round, so no actuarial calculation was performed.**
e.body:
**v-star**（仓库 `lubasinkal/v-star`）**是一个**用 Go 写的**零依赖精算引擎****——**逐字自述为**「**# v-star: The Actuarial Engine That Doesn**」**——**逐字續**「**’t Suck**」**，**并**逐字开场**「**Your calculations just got millions of times faster.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**另一种语言的同题材实现，**以及**仓库里那份给 AI 代理的文件**」**。

**引号约定（本条）**：**所引英文原文含 ASCII 撇号**（**如**「**Doesn**」**——**逐字續**「**’t**」、「**you**」**——**逐字續**「**’re**」、「**Who**」**——**逐字續**「**’s**」**）**，**本站按既有约定一律写作弯撇号 **U+2019****。

**可核实信息（均仓库元数据与仓库内文件实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 名字的来历被写明，**而**它来自一句课堂玩笑****——**逐字为**「**Why the name? Comes from a joke in class: if premiums compound at rate **j** but you**」**——**逐字續**「**’re discounting at **i**, the new discount factor is **v\*** = (1+j) × v. The star marks the difference.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处值得记**：**⭐ 即**一个**工具的命名**可以**直接把**它**要处理的**那个技术细节**（**在这里是**「**复利与**折现**用两个不同利率**时**那个**修正折现因子**」**）**写在说明里**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**比一个**只有品牌感的**名字**更容易被**后来者**理解与**检验**。**⭐⭐ ② 能力表把每一项翻成「**对你意味着什么**」****——**⭐ 逐字列出的能力含**：**现值（**标准折现因子与 **v\* 折现因子）**、**年金（**终身、**定期、**递延，**并用**真实的**生命表）**、**准备金（**净保费、**毛保费、**前瞻法、**追溯法）**、**蒙特卡洛（**几何布朗运动与 **Vasicek 均值回复；**逐字**「**100k paths in ~27ms**」**）**、**风险度量（**VaR、**CTE、**期望短缺与**置信区间）**、**多重减因（**把死亡、**退保与**失能合成一张表）**、**大 CSV 流式（**逐字**「**Stream millions of rows without blowing up your RAM**」**）**、**HTTP 接口（**逐字**「**Call from Python, R, Excel via REST endpoints**」**）以及**零依赖（**逐字**「**Standard library only. No pip, no npm, no version hell**」**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**最后一条最值得注意**：**⭐ 即**它**把**「**不用装任何包**」**当成**一条产品特性**来卖**——**⭐ 对**受管制环境**里的**部署与**审计**而言**，**这一条的**分量**可能**比性能更大**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 基准是在一台**具体型号的笔记本**上逐项给出的，**并**与两个**通用工具**对比****——**⭐ 逐字**说明测试机为 **Intel i5-8250U**（**1.6–3.4 GHz、**8 核、**NVMe SSD，**并**逐字注明**「**Plugged in**」**）**；**⭐ 逐项基准含**：**CSV 解析 **1,000 万行／**288 MB** 用 **0.80 秒**（**逐字**「**12.6M rows/s**」**）**、**单次现值**直接调用 **2.6 纳秒**（**逐字**「**380M / second**」**）**、**终身年金（**90 期）** **512 纳秒**、**蒙特卡洛 **10 万条路径 × **10 步 **27 毫秒**、**风险报告（**VaR ＋ **CTE，**10 万笔损失）** **0.42 毫秒**、**以及**并行估值 **1,000 万张保单 **37 毫秒****；**⭐ 并**另给**两张对比表**（**CSV：**逐字列出 **Polars **约 **535 毫秒／**约 **500 MB** 与 **Pandas **约 **30 秒／**超过 **2 GB****；**蒙特卡洛：**逐字列出 **Python/Numpy **约 **2 秒** 与 **R **约 **5 秒****）**。**⭐ 本词条**如实标注**：**上述数字**全部取自**其自述**，**本次**未复现**任何一项**；**⭐ 而**它**同时写明**内存口径**（**逐字**「**The mmap path uses OS page cache (lazily paged, released to OS under memory pressure). The streaming path keeps memory constant regardless of file size.**」**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一句**值得记**：**⭐ 即**它**没有**只报一个**好看的时间**，**而**说明了**这个时间**是用**操作系统的页缓存**换来的**、**以及**另一条**流式路径**的内存**恒定**。**⭐⭐ ④ 仓库里**除了 Go 代码，**还有**一个 **Zig 子目录**与**一份 **`AGENTS.md`****——**⭐ 本次实测**共 **103 个文件**，**其中**按目录计**最大者**为 **`pkg/reader`（**14**）**、**⭐ 其次为 **`zig/src`（**11**）**、**`pkg/server`（**9**）**、**`pkg/writer`（**7**）**、**`cmd/v-star`（**6**）**、**`pkg/stochastic`（**6**）**、**`pkg/mortality`（**5**）**、**`pkg/rates`（**5**）**、**`pkg/annuities`／**`pkg/concurrency`／**`pkg/reserves`（**各 **3**）**；**⭐ **23 个 Go 测试文件****；**⭐ 文档**含 **README **12,650 字节****、**`docs/DESIGN.md` **18,484 字节****、**`CHANGELOG.md` **2,456 字节****、**`ROADMAP.md` **3,743 字节****、**`CONTRIBUTING.md` **1,943 字节****、**以及 **`docs/adr/API_FREEZE_AUDIT.md` **2,738 字节****。**⭐ 而 **`AGENTS.md`（**764 字节**）逐字为**：**「**Zero-dependency actuarial engine. Go 1.26.1, stdlib only.**」**，**并**逐字给出三条约定**：**「**Go stdlib only. `go fmt` before commits. Table-driven tests, `1e-9` float tolerance.**」**，**以及**一节 **Graphify**（**逐字**「**Knowledge graph at `graphify-out/`. Invoke with `skill: "graphify"`. After code edits: `graphify update .` (AST-only, no API cost).**」**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这份 764 字节的文件**说明了三件事**：**⭐ 即**语言与**依赖边界**（**只用**标准库）**、**数值**容差**（**`1e-9`**）**、**以及**代码改动后**要更新**一张**知识图**（**且**逐字说明**只做 **AST、**不产生** API 费用**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ ⚠️ 两处**内部不一致，**如实记录**：**① **README 的 **「**What**」**——**逐字續**「**’s Coming Next?**」**一节仍把 **v0.8.0** 列为**将来**，**而**`CHANGELOG.md` 显示 **0.8.0** 已于 **2026-05-27** 发布、**0.9.0** 于 **2026-05-29** 发布**——**⭐ 即**README 的路线图**落后于**变更日志**；**② **该节**同时**把 **v1.0.0** 的目标写成**「**Stable API, 90%+ test coverage**」**——**⭐ 即**作者**自述**测试覆盖率**尚未**达到 **90%****。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[basic-term-model-rust]] 是**另一种语言的**同类实现**（**Rust**）**、**[[actuarial-ts]] 是 **TypeScript 实现**、**[[financecore-jl]] 是 **Julia 实现**、**[[lifelib-products]] 与**[[actuarialmath]]、**[[actuarialpy]] 覆盖**精算模型库**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**零依赖的 **Go 精算引擎**，**且**把**基准、**内存口径与**命名来由**一并写在说明里**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **名字**要能**解释自己**（**⭐ 本条用**一个**折现因子**解释了**名字**）**；**② **性能**要给出**测试机型号**、**对比对象**与**内存口径**，**而不是**只报一个**倍数**；**③ **零依赖**在**受管制环境**里**本身**就是一项**特性**；**④ **给 AI 代理的说明文件**要**写明**三件事**：**依赖边界、**数值容差、**改完代码后**要做什么**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装、**没有运行**该引擎**（**未做任何**现值、**年金、**准备金或**蒙特卡洛计算**）**，**故**不主张**其**任何基准数字**、**不主张**其**计算结果正确**、**也不主张**其**任何公式**符合**任何精算标准**。**② ⚠️ **`AGENTS.md` 的内容**本次**只读了开头**（**⭐ 全文 **764 字节**，**本次**读到约定与 **Graphify 两节**）**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**其 **Zig 子目录**的**用途与完成度**（**⭐ 本词条**不推测**其**与 Go 主程序**的关系**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**其测试覆盖率**（**⭐ 只知**作者**自述**目标为 **90% 以上**，**即**当前**低于该值**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**其**生命表来源与**许可**（**⭐ README 只提到**使用**真实生命表**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**其 **HTTP 接口**是否**默认**需要**鉴权**（**⭐ README 给出的是**本地 **`localhost:8080` 示例**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**该仓库**创建于 **2026-03-17**、**最后推送 **2026-07-30**（**均在**解冻窗口之外**）**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**零依赖的 **Go 精算引擎**，**并**把**命名来由、**基准口径与**给 AI 代理的约定**写在明处**」这一形态**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该引擎**是**开源工具**，**不是**任何持牌精算意见**，**其输出**用于**正式评估前**必须**由使用者**独立验证**。

Invoke with `skill: "graphify"`. After code edits: `graphify update .` (AST-only, no API cost).**）**。**⭐ 這份 764 位元組的檔案說明了三件事**：**語言與依賴邊界**、**數值容差 `1e-9`**、**以及改完代碼後要更新一張知識圖**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ ⚠️ 兩處內部不一致**：**① README 的 What**」**——**逐字續**「**’s Coming Next?**」一節仍把 v0.8.0 列為將來**，**而 `CHANGELOG.md` 顯示 0.8.0 已於 2026-05-27 發布、**0.9.0 於 2026-05-29 發布**——**⭐ 即**路線圖落後於變更日誌**；**② 該節把 v1.0.0 目標寫成 Stable API, 90%+ test coverage**——**⭐ 即**自述測試覆蓋率**尚未**達到 90%**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[basic-term-model-rust]]（**Rust**）、[[actuarial-ts]]（**TypeScript**）、[[financecore-jl]]（**Julia**）、[[lifelib-products]]、[[actuarialmath]]、[[actuarialpy]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**零依賴的 Go 精算引擎，**且把基準、**內存口徑與命名來由一併寫在說明裡**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

This repository **is a zero-dependency actuarial engine written in Go**, whose readme titles itself the actuarial engine that does not suck and opens by claiming that the reader calculations just got millions of times faster. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the same subject implemented in another language, together with the instruction file for AI coding agents that such repositories now ship.**

**Note on quotation: the English passages quoted here contain ASCII apostrophes, such as those in the contraction in the title, the contraction in the phrase about discounting, and the possessive in the roadmap heading, and this project follows its existing convention of writing them as a typographic apostrophe.**

**Verified information, all measured from repository metadata and the files inside the repository**: **first, the name origin is written out, and it comes from a classroom joke.** The readme explains that if premiums compound at one rate while discounting happens at another, the new discount factor becomes the product of one plus the compounding rate and the ordinary discount factor, and that the star marks the difference. **A tool name that explains the technical detail it exists to handle is easier for later readers to understand and check than a name that carries only branding.** **Second, the capability table translates each feature into what it means for the reader.** The listed capabilities are present values with standard and modified discount factors; annuities of whole life, term and deferred kinds using real mortality tables; reserves under net premium, gross premium, prospective and retrospective methods; Monte Carlo simulation with geometric Brownian motion and a mean-reverting rate model, quoted at a hundred thousand paths in about twenty-seven milliseconds; risk measures including value at risk, conditional tail expectation, expected shortfall and confidence intervals; multiple decrements combining death, lapse and disability into one table; streaming of very large CSV files without exhausting memory; an HTTP interface callable from other languages; and zero dependencies, described as standard library only with no package managers and no version conflicts. **That last item is the most notable: the absence of dependencies is sold as a product feature, and in a regulated environment its weight may exceed that of performance.** **Third, benchmarks are given item by item on a named laptop processor and compared with two general-purpose tools.** The readme names the test machine and notes that it was plugged in, then reports ten million CSV rows of two hundred and eighty-eight megabytes parsed in eight tenths of a second, a single present value call at two point six nanoseconds when called directly, a whole-life annuity over ninety terms in five hundred and twelve nanoseconds, a hundred thousand Monte Carlo paths over ten steps in twenty-seven milliseconds, a risk report over a hundred thousand losses in less than half a millisecond, and a parallel valuation of ten million policies in thirty-seven milliseconds, with separate comparison tables showing dataframe tools an order of magnitude slower. **This entry states plainly that every one of those numbers comes from the project own account and that none was reproduced here, and notes that the readme also states its memory accounting, explaining that the memory-mapped path uses the operating system page cache lazily while the streaming path keeps memory constant regardless of file size, so a fast time is not reported without saying what it was traded for.** **Fourth, the repository contains not only Go code but also a Zig subdirectory and an instruction file for AI coding agents.** Of a hundred and three files, the largest groups are the reader package, then a Zig source directory of eleven files, then the server, writer, command, stochastic, mortality and rates packages, alongside twenty-three Go test files and documentation including a twelve-kilobyte readme, an eighteen-kilobyte design document, a changelog, a roadmap, a contributing guide and an architecture decision record about an API freeze. **The instruction file for agents is seven hundred and sixty-four bytes and states that the engine is zero-dependency with a specific Go version and standard library only, that formatting must run before commits, that tests are table-driven with a floating point tolerance of one part in a billion, and that a knowledge graph under a named output directory must be updated after code edits using an AST-only path that costs no API calls.** **Fifth, two internal inconsistencies are recorded plainly**: the readme roadmap section still lists an earlier version as forthcoming although the changelog shows both that version and a later one already released in May, so the roadmap lags the changelog; and the same section sets a future target of a stable API with test coverage above ninety percent, which means the author states that coverage has not yet reached that level. **Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover a Rust term model, a TypeScript actuarial package, a Julia finance core and several actuarial model libraries in R and Python, **while this entry supplies a zero-dependency Go actuarial engine that writes its naming origin, its benchmark accounting and its conventions for AI agents into the open. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: name a tool so that the name explains itself; give the test machine, the comparison target and the memory accounting rather than a bare speed-up factor; treat the absence of dependencies as a feature in regulated settings; and in an instruction file for AI agents state the dependency boundary, the numerical tolerance and what must be done after an edit.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the engine was not installed and not run**, so no present value, annuity, reserve or simulation was computed, **and no claim is made about any benchmark number, about the correctness of any result or about whether any formula conforms to any actuarial standard**. **Second, the instruction file was read only at its beginning**, the whole file being seven hundred and sixty-four bytes and the conventions and knowledge graph sections being those read here. **Third, the purpose and completeness of the Zig subdirectory were not verified, and this entry does not speculate about its relationship to the Go program. Fourth, its test coverage was not verified**, only that the stated target is above ninety percent and therefore not yet reached. **Fifth, the source and licensing of its mortality tables were not verified. Sixth, whether its HTTP interface requires authentication by default was not verified**, the readme giving only a localhost example. **Seventh, on the window: the repository was created in March and last pushed at the end of July, both outside the thaw window**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap is a zero-dependency Go actuarial engine that puts its naming origin, its benchmark accounting and its conventions for AI agents in plain sight. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the engine is an open-source tool rather than a licensed actuarial opinion, and that its output must be independently validated before any formal use.**
